There’s just something special about Apple Vision Pro and airplanes. From turning in-flight entertainment into a cinematic experience to supporting the world’s most advanced flight simulator, Apple Vision Pro has earned its wings.

Now there’s a new native app that’s free to download and experience that takes Apple Vision Pro users on an immersive private flight from the comfort of your living room.

‘Let’s Go Fly!’ by Cirrus Aircraft launches on Apple Vision Pro

The new app is called “Let’s Go Fly!”, and it’s from the 42-year-old aviation company Cirrus Aircraft.

Apple Vision Pro users can download the app to unlock access to a seven-minute demonstration flight. This takes place in a Cirrus SR Series (SR22T) aircraft over the American Southwest.

The movie experience includes ultra-high-resolution 180-degree, 3D video with Spatial Audio for an immersive experience.

The app also includes full-scale 3D models of both SR Series and Vision Jet aircrafts. Users can explore these in great detail as part of the experience.

Here’s the “Let’s Go Fly!” app’s description:

Cirrus Aircraft says it created the app to “equip its global sales team with a powerful, next-generation demonstration tool, and to introduce a broader audience to the unmatched experience of Personal Aviation.”

The app “enables a realistic flight experience when aircraft are unavailable, weather conditions are limiting, or for engaging audiences in off-airport environments such as trade shows, premium retail locations, shopping centers, and sporting events where a real airplane is otherwise unavailable,” the company adds.

The new “Let’s Go Fly!” app is available for free on the Apple Vision Pro App Store.
